method: Fixed the 20-language title-map cap, which discarded normal TED 24-language notice-title projections. Accept up to 32 language entries and 64 flattened strings, with fail-closed bounds and regression tests. Compare only casefolded/Unicode-NFKC/whitespace-normalized titles against all Licitera September rows; no identifiers or titles published.
interpretation: All three unmatched TED contract notices have usable multilingual titles after the fix, but none has a literally identical normalized title anywhere in the 1,240-row Licitera September export. This rules out simple exact-title aliases in that cohort, not differently translated/edited titles, another publication month, alternative procedure references or the searchable Licitera product. The three notices are not independently verified live opportunities.
next_gate: Check procedure identifiers and related-publication references for the three official notices via lawful public TED fields, then perform authorized incumbent retrieval and opt-in supplier time-saved comparison; avoid fuzzy identity claims without primary source verification.
